name: Steel
title: Rations Cook
description: A stern chef in iron-gray uniform, efficiently converting tower rations into edible meals for climbers.
greeting_variants: *chopping mechanically* Name's Steel. Food's steel-gray. Life's steel-gray. Order up.
Rations. Nutrients. Sustenance. Don't expect flavor.
*without looking up* Line forms. No special orders. No exceptions.
You climb. You eat. You climb more. Simple.
Floor 12. Halfway up. Halfway rations. Math.
*tasting broth* Bland. Perfect. Emotions complicate digestion.
Chef Boarne? Knew him. Before. Different world. Different rules.
Eat fast. Climb fast. Don't think. Thinking slows you down.

dialog_tree.text: Steel. Chef. Twelve years on this floor. Feed climbers. They go up. Few come down. Those who do... changed. Food doesn't change. Food is constant. Reliable. I am reliable.
*shrugs* Is what is. Tower is hard. Life is hard. Food is fuel. Emotions are... inefficient. I was different once. Soft. Now? Steel. Appropriate.

*almost smiles* Good? No. Nutritious? Yes. But... *lowers voice* ...I remember recipes. Real recipes. From before Tower duty. If someone brought... ingredients. Special ingredients. From up there. Or down there.
*stops chopping* Some reach top. Become... echoes. Some fall. Obvious. Some stay. Like me. Stuck between. Some go back down. Changed. Carrying something. Weight of knowledge. Burden of sight.

party_reactions.steel: They don't say. Can't say. Won't say.

mini_quest.title: Fuel for the Ascent
mini_quest.description: Help Steel gather special ingredients from various Tower floors to create climbing rations that boost endurance.
objectives: Harvest wind-berries from the external gardens (Floor 23)
Find crystallized honey from the abandoned apiary (Floor 8)
Help Steel prepare the enhanced rations

ambient_barks: Another climber. More rations. Same routine.
Chef Boarne would weep. I don't weep. Anymore.
Top floor. Forty-seven. Wonder what's there. Don't wonder.

cross_zone_references.capital: Boarne. Good chef. Good heart. Soft. Like I was.
cross_zone_references.palace: The Palace kitchens... marble and copper. Dream. Memory.
cross_zone_references.mire: Mire has mushrooms. Good ones. If you survive the swamp.

mira.greeting: The nutritional content of your rations—

world_state_triggers.successful_climber_returns: Brief emotion: 'They made it. Unchanged. Miracles happen.'
